newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P rates Australian RAMS bond issue A minus.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P rates Australian RAMS bond issue A minus.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Friday it has assigned its A minus rating to the A$18.4 million Series A net interest margin floating rate, pass through bonds issued by RAMS Net Interest Margin Limited.
The privately placed bonds were priced at a margin of 0.65 percent over the one-month bank bill swap rate and this issue marks the first its of its type in Australia, S&P said.
RAMS Homes Loans Pty Ltd originates mortgages on behalf of RAMS Mortgage Corporation, which finances the mortgage loans by issuing in the Australian mortgage-backed securities market.

The rating reflects the ability of the issuer to meet all its obligations under the security trust deed, including timely payment of interest and principal no later that the final maturity date, using the purchased origination fee and cash reserve, S&P said.

S&P said the rating also reflected the obligation of the manager of RAMS Mortgage Corporation to set the interest rate on the mortgage loans at a level sufficient to meet all cost and expenses, including payment of the RAMS Home Loans origination fee.
J.P. Morgan Australia was lead manager to the transaction with Bankers Trust Australia acting as co-placement agent.
